# Transform operations index

One file per operation in `operations/`.

| File | Operation | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `account-attribute` | Account attribute | Look up an account for a particular source on an identity. |
| `base64-decode` | Base64 decode | Render base64 data in its original binary format. |
| `base64-encode` | Base64 Encode | Encode data with a Base64-based text encoding scheme. |
| `concatenation` | Concatenation | Join two or more string values into a combined output. |
| `conditional` | Conditional | Output different values depending on simple conditional logic. |
| `date-compare` | Date Compare | Compare two dates and return a calculated value. |
| `date-format` | Date Format | Convert datetime strings from one format to another. |
| `date-math` | Date Math | Add, subtract, and round components of a timestamp's incoming value. |
| `decompose-diacritical-marks` | Decompose Diacritical Marks | Clean or standardize symbols used within language. |
| `display-name` | Display Name | Use Preferred Name over Given Name to create an identity’s Display Name. |
| `e164-phone` | E.164 Phone | Convert a phone number string into an E.164-compatible number. |
| `first-valid` | First Valid | Return the first piece of data that is not null. |
| `generate-random-string` | Generate Random String | Generate a random string of any length. |
| `get-end-of-string` | Get End of String | Get the rightmost N characters of a string. |
| `get-reference-identity-attribute` | Get Reference Identity Attribute | Get another user's identity attribute. |
| `identity-attribute` | Identity Attribute | Get a user's identity attribute's value. |
| `index-of` | Index Of | Get the location of a specific substring within a value. |
| `iso-3166` | ISO3166 | Convert a string into an ISO 3166 country code value. |
| `join` | Join | Join two or more string values into a combined output with a defined separator. |
| `last-index-of` | Last Index Of | Returns last location of specific substring. |
| `left-pad` | Left Pad | Left pad of the input string. |
| `lookup` | Lookup | Look up and return a key's matching value. |
| `lower` | Lower | Convert an input string into all lowercase letters. |
| `name-normalizer` | Name Normalizer | Clean or standardize the spelling of strings coming in from source systems. |
| `random-alphanumeric` | Random Alphanumeric | Generate a random string of any length. |
| `random-numeric` | Random Numeric | Generate a random number of any length. |
| `reference` | Reference | Reuse a transform that has already been written. |
| `replace-all` | Replace All | Find and replace all instances of all patterns. |
| `replace` | Replace | Find and replace all instances of a single string. |
| `rfc-5646` | RFC5646 | Convert three-letter abbreviation to RFC5646 language tag. |
| `right-pad` | Right Pad | Add padding to the right of an incoming string. |
| `rule` | Rule | Reuse rule logic that has already been written for a previous use case. |
| `split` | Split | Return the Nth element of a split array. |
| `static` | Static | Return a fixed string value. |
| `substring` | Substring | Get the inner portion of a string passed into the transform. |
| `trim` | Trim | Trim whitespaces from both the beginning and ending of input strings. |
| `upper` | Upper | Convert an input string into all uppercase letters. |
| `username-generator` | Username Generator | Derive a unique value for an attribute in an account create profile. |
| `uuid-generator` | UUID Generator | Create a universal unique ID (UUID). |
